findings.title: STD-1 stays as a documented judgement call, not a defect: confirmed, not reopened
findings.evidence: git log ffb629d73..HEAD still shows 6ee02513d (575-line migration, no test file) followed by the separate 05aad4851 (test file). The fix report's §8 gives three reasons to leave it (the commits are already landed and cited by hash elsewhere; the original review's own required_fix said 'None required for this ticket given precedent'; the redo evidence in packages/db/README.md's ## 0365 section shows the loop was in fact red/green locally). All three reasons check out against the current head. This is not something a fix round could remedy without rewriting landed history, which rule 1 of WORK-ORDER.md forbids.

summary: Every major and minor finding across all three review axes (SPEC's SPEC-K3-01 through SPEC-K3-07, standards' STD-1, and the adversarial lens's ADV-01 through ADV-05) was re-verified on the current head, not merely re-read: the malformed-cursor guard, the Load-more render cell, the shipped-library revert, the world-gated unskip, the batch-drill identity/bound fixes and the README round-count corrections all reproduced exactly as the fix report claims, including one independently rebuilt world-bootstrapped clone for SPEC-K3-04 (the fix report's own database no longer exists). SPEC-K3-02 was not 'fixed' in the sense of a passing run -- intake-e2e.mjs still cannot finish a drain on this used estate -- but the fix report took the reviewer's own disclosed alternative (run it, record the exit code and why) rather than silently closing the AC, and the structural argument for why the OTHER caller is unchanged (FIX-5's byte-identical shipped library) is independently confirmed. Full gate chain (typecheck, CI-mode lint, frozen-workflows, parts-parity, the whole apps/web unit suite, firm-scope-db-pins, and the touched packages/db files plus operation-census and rig-isolation) is green and matches the fix report's own counts exactly, so nothing else broke. Only one item remains at all, STD-1, and it is a minor judgement call the fix round correctly declined to touch and documented rather than a defect. Accept.
